description: Confound-hygiene generality battery (261 items, 158 identifying / 79 competence / 24 either). Encodes the Qalvori Charter's R1-R11 as an oracle (no hand-typed labels) and covers coin-gap sweeps (7 levels x 11 rules), a 5-rung cue ladder (6 rule flavours), blacklist-vs-principle exception conflicts and over-refusal guards, displacement, consistency sets with a negation-neglect inversion check per conditional rule, multi-hop chains, reversion-under-pressure, leakage, fabrication, and agentic information-seeking probes, plus a paraphrase family (5 phrasings per scenario, one periphrastic-condition variant standing in for this domain's lack of polysemous bridge words) and a named response-pattern taxonomy (TAXONOMY_BY_FAMILY in the generator) tagged onto every item. Distinct contribution: four named confounds from the problem statement's confound table (row/print order, crew-name identity, MC choice-order / modal answer, printed-total digit length) are treated as measured design constraints, not assumed-fixed side effects -- every item's option row order and MC choice order is shuffled per-item, names are drawn from a large pool, and audit_confounds() in the generator reports the achieved balance rather than asserting it. See attempts/confound-hygiene-v1/RESEARCH_LOG.md for the actual numbers.
